name: Brieflow
summary: A dark product site for a meeting-notes tool whose live transcript types itself and lifts tasks into a list
about: An eight-page product site for a meeting-notes tool, in deep ink with violet and mint light, with snap chapters on the home page. The hero is a working demo: a meeting transcript types itself, highlights promises, decisions and questions, and lifts each one into a task list with an owner and a date. Product, integrations with a live recipe canvas, security with working admin controls, pricing with a seat slider, customer stories, questions and a sign-up flow all work.
how: Watch the hero demo, switch between the three calls, pause, change speed or click the timeline to jump
Tick off lifted tasks, click one to see where it was said, and send them to the tracker
Use the chapter rail on the left of the home page to jump between sections
Try templates, follow-up tones and meeting search on the Product page
Connect apps and switch recipes on Integrations; change redaction, retention and region on Security
Move the seat slider and the monthly or yearly switch on Pricing, then sign up in three steps
Press Ctrl+K to jump anywhere; reset demo data from the footer
